subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw permanently own the Agentic OS lease RPC protocol and its shared-state persistence, or should core expose only a generic host-authorized spawn seam for an external plugin/integration to own?
rationale: This is a new public Gateway API, authorization boundary, and persisted compatibility commitment; source review cannot determine whether maintainers want that external product contract in core.

options.title: Require an owner-neutral core seam
options.body: Keep any generic runner authorization primitive in core, while moving Agentic OS method names, metadata protocol, lease semantics, discovery, and durable records to the owning integration.

options.title: Sponsor the core protocol
options.body: Explicitly accept the Agentic OS RPC names and snapshot schema as maintained OpenClaw public API, then require upgrade, compatibility, and current-head runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Close or defer the branch if maintainers do not want to support this external orchestration contract in core.

recommendation.title: Require an owner-neutral core seam
recommendation.body: Keep any generic runner authorization primitive in core, while moving Agentic OS method names, metadata protocol, lease semantics, discovery, and durable records to the owning integration.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for a repository-wide Gateway and public API boundary decision.
